description: This Java interface defines a client for interacting with Hono's Device Connection API, including methods to set and get the last known gateway for a device, with tracing support.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionClient
classes.description: An interface for a client that interacts with Hono's Device Connection API, scoped to a specific tenant, providing methods to set and retrieve the last gateway for a device.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last gateway that acted on behalf of a device, with support for tracing context, returning a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last gateway that acted on behalf of a device, returning a Future with the gateway ID or failing if none is set.
